name: How often should interior walls be repainted?

mainEntity.name: How often should interior walls be repainted?

acceptedAnswer.text: The frequency of interior repainting depends on several factors, including the room's use, wear and tear, and your personal preference for a fresh look. High-traffic areas like hallways, kitchens, and bathrooms may need repainting every 3-5 years due to increased exposure to dirt, moisture, and scuffs. Bedrooms and living rooms typically require repainting every 5-7 years. Quality of the previous paint job and paint type also influence longevity. Ultimately, repainting when the current finish shows signs of fading, chipping, or excessive scuffs is a good guideline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repainting frequency varies by room use; high-traffic areas every 3-5 years, others every 5-7 years. Repaint when paint shows fading, chipping, or scuffs.
